findings.current: At the same time, the thirty uninvited guests in bamboo hats parted to either side.
findings.defect: The translation omits that the bamboo hats were pulled low.
findings.rationale: The source specifies 죽립을 눌러쓴, describing the guests as wearing their bamboo hats pulled low; merely saying they were in bamboo hats loses that physical detail.
findings.replacement: At the same time, the thirty uninvited guests, their bamboo hats pulled low, parted to either side.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor physical-detail omission.
